semiconductor_relevance: High — DONGIL TECHNOLOGY specializes in ESD/EMC solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: DONGIL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. provides advanced ESD and EMI/EMC solutions designed to neutralize static charges and suppress electromagnetic noise in semiconductor manufacturing. With a strong focus on R&D and over 40 years of experience, the company offers reliable products that enhance yield and process efficiency in both front-end and back-end semiconductor applications.
capabilities: ESD ionizers and sensors for static control
High-voltage power supplies (HVPS) for ESD solutions

regional_presence.Korea: The company is established in Hwaseong, Korea, and has a significant manufacturing presence there.
